title: Restore route focus with a guaranteed accessible heading
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that Routes.razor FocusOnNavigate targets h1 while representative routed pages render MudBlazor h4/h5 headings and no h1. Focus restoration therefore silently fails on much of the route surface. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Components/Routes.razor and Components/Pages/*.razor. Standardize a real h1 or guaranteed route heading selector and add representative keyboard/navigation coverage.
